**Finding: compliant (preferred position).**

The agreement contains no employee non-solicitation, no-poach or no-hire covenant of any kind. Searches across the full document for "solicit", "employ or engage", "hire"/"no-hire", "induce", "recruit", "employment", "personnel" and restrictive-covenant phrasing returned nothing responsive; the sole reference to employees is in the Section 6.3(i) indemnity definition of "Indemnified Person". Our party (the Issuer and Depositor) is therefore unrestricted in hiring or approaching Cellco personnel, which satisfies the preferred position "No non-solicit on Customer." No redline proposed.
